  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to align backend architecture with overall product strategy and user experience

  • Direct experience with GCP and knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud providers
  • Efficiency in ideation and implementation, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and impact
  • Preferred: Experience with Docker

title: Senior Go Developer (f/m/d) – Focus on gRPC & Enterprise Applications
description:
You'd build the Natuvion Cloud Portal, the Go/gRPC platform at the center of the company. It's the cloud counterpart to our core products and the central access point nearly every team works through, used by our own people and our customers alike. A year old, already the strategic core, mostly greenfield, and growing fast.

What to expect

The work is varied, and the problems rarely repeat. One stretch you might be making multi-tenant queries fly across 100 GiB+ tables in DuckDB; the next, packing a couple dozen services into a single binary a customer can run on-prem, or building our AI firewall, deep-packet inspection for AI traffic that decides, per customer and per user, exactly which AI tools and MCP servers are allowed. It's the kind of fine-grained control that enterprises with sensitive data actually need and almost nobody has built.

The stack is deliberately solid, though we'll reach for newer tools where the benefit is substantial. Go and gRPC throughout, with Google's AIPs as a strict ruleset so our APIs stay compatible as the platform grows. We run on AWS/EKS and on-prem with no vendor lock-in, backed by PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, OpenSearch and a Grafana/Loki/Mimir/Jaeger stack, all shipped through GitHub Actions. Authorization is one such case: the platform's entire authz system is built on SpiceDB/Zanzibar, newer and less battle-tested, but exactly the right tool for the job. There's a dedicated SRE team, but you build it, you run it. You'd join four backend engineers, a flat team with a hands-on technical lead, and we're hiring across backend and frontend to keep up.

Your Responsibilities :

  • Design and build the gRPC services at the heart of the Cloud Portal, APIs that other teams depend on and that must stay compatible as the platform grows

title: Backend Engineer – API Integrationen, Connectoren, Worker/Jobs, Mailer Service, QA
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend Engineer – API Integrationen, Connectoren, Worker/Jobs, Mailer Service, QA based in Germany.

This role is an opportunity to build robust backend systems and integrations that connect critical business platforms and services. You’ll work across APIs, connectors, background jobs, messaging, email delivery, persistence, and quality assurance. The position requires an engineering mindset focused on reliability, traceability, and handling real-world failure scenarios rather than relying on happy-path implementations. You’ll design integrations that remain resilient through rate limits, webhooks, timeouts, retries, and other operational challenges. Working on a project basis, you’ll have significant ownership over technical deliverables and architecture decisions. This is a strong fit for a backend engineer who enjoys solving complex integration problems and building dependable production systems.


Accountabilities
  • Build and maintain production-ready API integrations and connectors, prioritizing Box and HubSpot, followed by Microsoft Graph, Asana, and billing-related systems.
  • Implement reliable authentication and integration patterns using OAuth, webhooks, pagination, rate limits, retries, and robust error handling.
  • Design and develop queue-driven, stateful, and replayable workers and background jobs.
  • Build and maintain a mailer service supporting PDF attachments, structured logging, retry mechanisms, delivery checks, and deduplication/idempotency.
  • Design database schemas and implement clean, reliable migrations using PostgreSQL or comparable technologies.
  • Implement audit events and persistent traceability mechanisms, including correlation IDs and observability across distributed processes.
  • Develop comprehensive QA coverage, including contract tests, integration tests, and end-to-end regression testing for critical workflows such as document delivery and deadline-related processes.
  • Use Docker, queue/eventing technologies, and observability practices to support reliable deployment and operation of backend services.
  • Proactively identify failure modes

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.

  • Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we’re hiring

  • We're post-PMF and revenue generating, launching in the US ahead of a Series A. Early enough that you'll shape how engineering works here, late enough that you're not gambling on whether the product works.

  • You'll own significant parts of the product and ship the things customers feel most. It's a regulated platform moving money across multiple jurisdictions, so the work has to be right and it still has to be fast.

  • We also want the bar to move while you're here. Senior engineers set the standard through the quality of what they ship, how they review, and the problems they choose to fix rather than work around.

  • Alongside that, we're rethinking how we build with AI. We use the tools, but we know there's a step change available to teams who redesign their whole workflow around them rather than adding AI to how they already work. If you've already done that somewhere else, you'll have a lot of room here.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and run non-trivial production systems, and you've learned what works in which situations rather than defaulting to one approach.

  • Strong architectural judgement. Most of our code is now written by an LLM, which means you need to own the decisions around it: how the system is structured, what the patterns are, whether the thing being built is the right thing at all. Our stack is Go, and if you learn quickly, not having written it isn't a problem.

title: Backend Developer (Java & Python, Microservices)
description:
Your mission

Your mission is to design and maintain a scalable, asynchronous backend that powers OKAPI:Orbits' end-to-end solutions across mission design, Space Situational Awareness (SSA), Space Traffic Management (STM), Flight Dynamics (FD), and Space Traffic Coordination (STC), supporting satellite operators throughout their entire mission lifecycle.

You'll work primarily on external customer projects with a Python-based tech stack, while also contributing in parallel to our products built on Java Spring Boot. You design and implement robust microservices that process and distribute large volumes of orbital and telemetry data to deliver reliable APIs and automation processes. You already bring solid experience and take independent ownership of parts of the backend architecture across both environments.

You'll work on the systems that enable satellite operators and space agencies to analyze, coordinate, and protect their missions in an increasingly crowded space environment.

Studies show that women are less likely to apply for a position if they don't meet 100% of the requirements. Please know that we explicitly encourage you to apply if this applies to you, as long as you bring a passion for space technology, reliable software development, and sustainable use of space.
OKAPI:Orbits already brings together a highly diverse team and is actively committed to growing that diversity further, since studies show that heterogeneous teams achieve better results and drive innovation.


Your tasks and responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain asynchronous, microservice-based backend systems, primarily in Python for external customer projects and in parallel in Java Spring Boot for our products
  • Implement and optimize data processing and distribution pipelines that handle large volumes of orbital, telemetry, and mission data
  • Design and maintain message-based communication structures between microservices (e.g., via RabbitMQ or comparable message brokers)
  • Collaborate closely with space engineers and scientists to translate mission-related requirements into scalable, robust software solutions
  • Share responsibility for the backend architecture across both tech stacks, with a focus on performance, fault tolerance, and maintainability
  • Plan and document implementation steps, from system architecture through deployment in a cloud-native environment
  • Ensure code quality, automated testing, and adherence to security and development standards
  • Advance CI/CD pipelines, observability, and automation to support stable, continuous releases
  • Analyze and resolve complex issues in distributed systems with a focus on efficiency and reliability
  • Work within small, interdisciplinary teams, contributing your backend expertise to cross-functional projects

At enabl, we're bringing AI into the physical world. While everyone else talks about automating office work, we're going after the biggest problem in logistics: 25 million industrial vehicles worldwide are still driven by hand.

Our hybrid system pairs the judgment of experienced drivers with modern automation, and it gets smarter with every deployment. Leading companies in logistics, automotive, and consumer goods already run on our technology.

We're looking for someone to join us by year's end and help build the roadmap to autonomous intralogistics from day one. You'll work on the "nervous system" of our tech. The software that keeps data transmission stable and low-latency, so our forklifts can be safely remote-controlled in real time, anywhere in Europe


What We Offer

  • Impact & ownership: our hierarchies are flat, so your ideas go straight into the roadmap and the product, not into a backlog someone else prioritizes.

  • A modern setup in Karlsruhe, with direct access to our test hall for running network tests right on the vehicle. Flexible hours, and remote work up to 50% of the time.

  • The enabl package: a tight-knit startup team, regular team events, a job ticket, free parking, and a kitchen stocked with snacks and drinks.

  • Real skin in the game: on top of a competitive salary, you get a direct stake in enabl's growth through our Employee Participation Plan (VSOP).


Your tasks

  • Develop our software stack in modern C++ and Python, ensuring stable communication between remotely operated vehicles and remote stations.
  • Keep video streams and control data running reliably even under changing network conditions — from writing the code to live-testing it on the vehicle.
  • You analyze and optimize WiFi environments on-site at our customers. From channel and interference analysis to coordinating with the customer's IT team.
  • You implement lasting fixes for connectivity issues directly in the code.
  • Set up test infrastructure and CI pipelines that let us simulate network scenarios automatically.
  • Help actively shape the roadmap for our connectivity stack.


Your profile

You've got solid C++ experience and hands-on WiFi know-how, plus you've gotten your hands dirty in at least one of these areas: network development, real-time systems, video pipelines (e.g. GStreamer), or robotics (e.g. ROS2). We'll teach you the rest.

description:
Es gibt eine fertige, moderne Codebasis, und wir suchen jemanden, der sie übernimmt. Das ist die ehrliche Beschreibung dieser Stelle.

Aufgaben

Qualifikation

Das Jahresgehalt startet bei 50.000 Euro und geht bis 70.000 Euro, abhängig davon, was du mitbringst, oder du auch Equity willst. Der eigentliche Unterschied zu einer größeren Firma ist ein anderer. Was du technisch entscheidest, ist entschieden, es gibt kein Gremium dahinter. Und was du baust, läuft ab dem nächsten Event bei echten Veranstaltern statt in einem Testsystem.

title: Flutter & Node.js Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) - Fully Remote
description:
memodio is a digital health application (DiGA) fighting forgetfulness and dementia 🧠 Our app is prescribed by doctors, fully reimbursed by German statutory health insurance, and recommended by leading medical associations. In a clinical trial with 140 participants, we showed that it measurably improves memory performance, everyday independence, and quality of life. More than 10,000 people already trust memodio.

We've been on the market for over five years. So we have the speed and ownership culture of a startup, without the chaotic early days: a validated product, paying reimbursement partners, and real users who notice when we ship something good. Now we're growing the engineering team.

Where you sit: anywhere in the world. We're a small distributed team, not a company with a remote policy bolted on. The one requirement is overlap: at least four hours of your working day between 09:00 and 18:00 Berlin time, because we solve problems together, not by throwing tickets over a wall.

How you join us: as an employee or as a freelancer, whichever fits your situation better. Tell us which you'd prefer when you apply.

Tasks

Our core product is live and helping thousands of people, but it's far from finished. A big part of this role is evolving the existing app to better fit the people who actually use it: adults aged 50+, often dealing with early-stage cognitive decline. Every improvement you make has a direct, visible effect on someone's day.

Beyond the core product we're building new and adjacent products, including ones with AI capabilities. If working with LLMs excites you, there's real room to shape that. If it doesn't, that's fine too.

How the role works

You won't get finished designs and implementation specs to execute. You'll get problems, context, and user needs and the freedom to figure out the best solution. That's deliberate: it's where the creativity and the ownership live. It also means the job asks you to think about what to build, not only how.

Today our CTO is hands-on in the codebase, supported by a part-time engineer. You'd join as the next full-time engineer on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.

Day to day

  • Frontend: evolve our Flutter app (iOS & Android), with a strong focus on good UX and usability for people aged 50+
  • Backend: design and build our Node.js APIs and services for new features
  • Product: work closely with our medical and product colleagues: your voice matters in what we build and how
  • Quality: help us keep code review, testing, and engineering standards at the level a regulated medical product demands
  • Optional: if DevOps interests you, there's room to shape our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and deployment but it isn't the core of the job

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Commercial Systems and Intelligence
description:
About the team:

The Commercial Systems and Intelligence squad is a newly formed team within SumUp's Acquisition Mission under the Run & Grow tribe. We sit at the intersection of data, backend engineering, and sales operations, building the infrastructure that powers how SumUp attributes merchant acquisition, calculates commissions, and understands the full lifecycle of every merchant.

Today, these processes are largely manual. We're here to change that, automating what's opaque, and building systems that sales representatives, leadership, and analysts can actually trust. You'll join at the very beginning, helping to shape how the squad works, the architecture it builds on, and the standards it holds itself to.

 

What you'll do:

  • Aggregating data from across the SumUp ecosystem to determine which acquisition channel or sales agent drove a merchant to take a valuable action (e.g. signing up, adopting a product)
  • Establishing data models, API contracts, and rule definitions that automate existing manual commission workflows for field and tele-sales agents, partnerships and merchant referrals
  • Build the Lifecycle Event Log in close collaboration with the Merchant Intelligence squad. A centralized store of curated merchant lifecycle events (signups, product usage, verification, purchases) used across attribution, recommendations, customer support and sales
  • Build internal backoffices and APIs for sales representatives and leaders to monitor commission and modify commission plans, manage portfolios and resolve disputes
  • Define and document API contracts, schemas, and integration patterns that other engineering teams can adopt confidently
  • Establish best practices for testing, observability, and incident response within a newly formed squad
  • Use AI and agentic coding tools deliberately, to scaffold services, write tests, explore unfamiliar code, and draft documentation while maintaining full accountability for what gets shipped

 

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
  • Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
  • Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable — fintech, payments, or similar domains
  • Have built services from scratch in greenfield, early-stage squads with limited prior context,  and are energized, not unsettled, by that challenge
  • Have experience with testing, observ

description:
Über uns

Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. 
  • KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. 
  • Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.
  • Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. 
  • Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft.
  • Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. 
  • AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen.
  • Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter.

description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.


The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect high-performance web applications and accelerate our development velocity across our B2B platform. You’ll play a pivotal role in bridging modern Nuxt 3/4 frontend applications—including customer management portals and embeddable widget engines—with a robust Laravel and Doctrine ORM backend API, delivering seamless experiences that connect millions of students to funding opportunities.

You will own the technical implementation of core products across our entire stack, working with PHP 8.2+, Laravel, MySQL, and Vue 3 / Nuxt 3/4. Beyond traditional engineering, this role champions efficiency: you will deeply integrate AI-native workflows (using tools like Cursor and Google Gemini) to double shipping velocity, automate test coverage, and build intelligent LLM-driven platform features. If you are passionate about full-stack architecture, widget infrastructure, and leveraging AI to build smarter and faster, this role is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Full Lifecycle Development: Architect, build, and ship end-to-end B2B features across the stack- from Laravel/Doctrine JSON:API endpoints to reactive Nuxt 3/4 Vue components and server routes.

  • Embed & Analytics Engine: Develop and optimize high-performance embedded widget systems, Nitro server engine logic, iframe cross-origin messaging, client event-tracking SDKs, and data ingestion pipelines.

  • API & Database Architecture: Design robust relational database schemas (MySQL), Doctrine entity mappings, clean migrations, performant RESTful/JSON:API contracts, and Redis caching layers.

Ein Schwerpunkt von KENBUN ist die automatische Spracherkennung (Speech-to-Text) im industriellen und medizinischen Umfeld. Für Deutsch verfügen wir bereits über sehr leistungsfähige Modelle. Aktuell bauen wir unsere französische Spracherkennung weiter aus und verfügen dafür über umfangreiche Trainingsdatensätze mit mehreren Millionen Beispielen.

Für die Qualität dieser Daten ist sprachliches Detailverständnis entscheidend: Sind Audio und Transkription wirklich korrekt? Werden Zahlen richtig geschrieben? Gibt es systematische Probleme mit Homophonen, zusammengezogenen Wörtern oder anderen Besonderheiten der französischen Sprache? Und welche Fehlermuster zeigt unser aktuelles Spracherkennungsmodell im praktischen Einsatz?

Zur Unterstützung suchen wir eine:*n Werkstudent:*in mit sehr guten Französischkenntnissen und soliden Python-Kenntnissen. Der Schwerpunkt der Tätigkeit liegt auf sprachwissenschaftlicher Qualitätskontrolle mit bestehenden Datensätzen und Modellen. Du arbeitest selbstständig mit unseren Tools und Daten, wirst dabei aber eng von unserem technischen und wissenschaftlichen Team begleitet.

Wenn Du zusätzlich Interesse an Machine Learning und Speech-to-Text-Modellen hast, kannst Du Dich gerne auch in weiterführende Themen wie Evaluation oder Modelltraining einarbeiten. Voraussetzung ist das jedoch nicht – wichtiger sind uns Dein Sprachgefühl, Deine analytische Arbeitsweise und Deine Fähigkeit, mit Python strukturiert Daten zu untersuchen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Aufgaben

  • Überprüfung französischer Audio- und Textdaten auf sprachliche und systematische Fehler
  • Analyse bestehender Datensätze mit Python und unseren vorhandenen Tools
  • Identifikation und Kategorisierung typischer Fehlermuster, z. B. bei Zahlen, Homophonen oder zusammengezogenen Wörtern
  • Interaktives Testen unserer französischen Speech-to-Text-Modelle durch eigene Spracheingaben
  • Optional: Mitarbeit bei Evaluation, Modelltraining oder weiteren Machine-Learning-Themen

Qualifikation

  • Französisch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2 oder vergleichbar)
  • Deutsch oder Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau
  • Solide Python-Kenntnisse: Du kannst bestehende Skripte verstehen, kleinere Anpassungen vornehmen und selbstständig mit Datensätzen arbeiten
  • Sehr gutes Sprachgefühl und Freude daran, sprachliche Besonderheiten und Fehler systematisch zu untersuchen
  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
  • Interesse an Spracherkennung, Sprachdaten oder Natural Language Processing von Vorteil
  • Machine-Learning-Erfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung

title: Werkstudent:in Business Operations
description:

Bei VESTIGAS baust du an der digitalen Grundlage der Bau-Lieferkette: Wir machen aus Bestellungen, Lieferscheinen und Rechnungen eine digitale, rechtssichere Plattform, die im Alltag von Bauunternehmen und Lieferanten genutzt wird. Du arbeitest an einem Produkt mit echter Marktdurchdringung in einem riesigen DACH-Mittelstandsmarkt, lieferst Ergebnisse iterativ und übernimmst Ownership für Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren müssen und nicht nur im Konzept.


Deine Rolle

Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Business Operations baust du mit am Betriebssystem von VESTIGAS: an den Prozessen, Daten und Formaten, mit denen wir das Unternehmen steuern – OKR-Prozess und All-Hands, Reporting und Kennzahlen, Datenqualität im CRM und die Automatisierung wiederkehrender Abläufe. Bei vielen dieser Themen stehen wir noch am Anfang: Du arbeitest nicht in fertigen Strukturen, sondern legst das Fundament mit.

Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Lust hat, Dinge selbst anzupacken – der verstehen will, wie es heute wirklich läuft, und daraus Prozesse und Daten macht, die auch bei doppelter Teamgröße noch tragen. Du arbeitest eng mit der Person zusammen, die diese Themen heute federführend vorantreibt: Du hältst ihr den Rücken frei, lernst unmittelbar von ihr und übernimmst mit der Zeit eigene Themen. Und du bekommst einen ehrlichen Blick darauf, wie ein schnell wachsendes Start-up von innen funktioniert.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt bei Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachhalten unserer wiederkehrenden Steuerungs- und Kommunikationsformate, insbesondere des OKR-Prozesses und unserer All-Hands – von der Aufbereitung der Inhalte bis zum Nachfassen bei den Verantwortlichen.

title: Verification Engineer
description:
At Ubitium, we believe the best engineering happens when people with different perspectives tackle hard problems together. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. What matters most is curiosity, skill, and the drive to build technology that improves the world. If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you. Our team members come from some of the best universities in the world and left some of the largest tech companies to build something truly remarkable.

Tasks

  • Build cocotb-based testbenches for RTL blocks ranging from complicated datapaths to multilevel interconnect, driven by property-based test generation rather than fixed directed vectors.Write SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) to catch protocol violations directly in simulation, plus cover property statements to close functional-coverage gaps.
  • Cross-check RTL behavior against independent golden reference models (including formally-specified models) to catch divergence between spec intent and implementation
  • Drive functional coverage closure, reviewing coverage reports
  • Debug failures using waveform viewers and simulator transcripts, working from a failing assertion or model mismatch back to a root cause in the RTL, the testbench, or the model.
  • Document and track open verification findings (RTL bugs, model gaps, or verification-methodology limitations) with clear reproduction steps, so issues are shareable and actionable across the team.
  • Continuously improve the verification infrastructure itself (build flows, test harnesses, coverage tooling).

Requirements

  • Languages: System Verilog, System Verilog Assertions, Python.
  • Skills: RTL debugging, Property Based Verification, Git.
  • Good to have: Formal Verification exposure.

Master’s degree (or equivalent) and 2+ years of hands-on experience in a relevant role. Relocation required. Currently 4 days on-site, 1 day remote. Policy may change.

Benefits

  • A verification methodology you help shape, not just execute. The team builds its own property-based test harnesses, cross-checks RTL against formally-specified golden models, and wires up both SVA and native SystemVerilog covergroups. If you have opinions on how verification should be done, there’s real room to introduce them.
  • Direct, tight feedback loops with the architects/designers. Findings get written up, discussed, and resolved collaboratively. You’ll see your root-cause analysis directly inform (or get corrected by) the people who wrote the RTL.
  • Exposure across the full stack of a RISC-V SoC.
  • Competitive salary plus stock options
  • 30+ days of paid vacation
  • Relocation support
  • Full German social security and universal healthcare
  • A modern office

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Infrastructure (all genders)
description:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The opportunity

As the Engineering Manager for the Infrastructure domain, you will lead the teams responsible for the foundations that power Distribusion's products and operations. Covering Platform Engineering, IT, and Information Security, your mission is to build scalable, secure, and reliable systems that enable our engineering teams and the wider business to operate at their best.

To prepare our technical foundation for 10x growth, we are looking for a highly strategic, business-oriented leader to transform how these critical functions operate. You will act as the crucial bridge between our infrastructure and the broader company by professionalising our tech stack, driving complex vendor negotiations, and building transparent roadmaps that clearly showcase your team's impact.

What you will do

  • You'll lead the teams that keep Distribusion running securely, reliably, and at scale.

  • From cloud infrastructure and developer tooling to internal IT and information security, you'll be responsible for the platforms and processes that enable our teams to move fast with confidence.

  • You'll grow and support a team spanning Platform Engineering, IT, and Security, helping define strategy, drive execution, and raise the bar for operational excellence across the company.

  • Vendor management including negotiating conditions and overseeing detailed infrastructure and project cost tracking.

  • Your work will directly impact the productivity of our engineers, the resilience of our systems, and the security of our business as we continue to scale globally.

Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid

We are mainly looking for this role to be based in Germany, preferably in our headquarters in Berlin.

title: Senior Product Manager
Backend QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend QA Engineer based in Germany.

Take ownership of quality across a high-traffic, backend-focused platform where reliability and precision are critical.
You’ll combine hands-on manual testing with automation to validate APIs, transaction lifecycles, data, and event-driven services.
The role gives you the opportunity to uncover edge cases and risks beyond what is explicitly defined in specifications.
You’ll work closely with engineers and other stakeholders to ensure robust releases and prevent critical issues from reaching production.
Your work will span REST and gRPC APIs, relational databases, message queues, and distributed backend services.
You’ll also contribute to automated regression coverage using Go and help continuously strengthen the testing approach.
Working fully remotely within a global team, you’ll have meaningful ownership in a fast-growing technology environment.


Accountabilities
  • Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories to design comprehensive test cases, scenarios, and coverage strategies.
  • Perform end-to-end testing of transaction lifecycles, including initiation, authorization, settlement, reconciliation, and related workflows.
  • Proactively explore the platform to identify edge cases, unexpected behavior, risks, and gaps not covered by existing specifications.
  • Validate data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across services using SQL queries against PostgreSQL and MySQL.
  • Test REST and gRPC APIs using tools such as Postman, grpcurl, or equivalent solutions, validating requests, responses, error handling, and edge cases.
  • Verify event-driven workflows across message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, and NATS, including retries, failures, ordering, and duplicate-message handling.
  • Write, maintain, and extend automated regression tests in Go, collaborating with developers when additional test coverage or technical support is required.
  • Log, prioritize, track, and manage defects in Jira, providing clear reproduction steps, payloads, logs, and relevant technical context.
  • Execute regression testing following deployments and help ensure releases meet expected quality standards.
  • Contribute to improving QA processes, automation coverage, and overall testing efficiency across the platform.

    • 4+ years of professional manual testing experience, with a strong focus on backend services, APIs, and distributed systems.
    • Previous experience testing products in iGaming, fintech, pay

title: Founding Senior Talent Partner
description:
About Odin

Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should be putting it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legals and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why We're Hiring

We're hiring across product, design, engineering, growth, legal and operations - and our US launch will add New York hiring on top of that. Hiring the right people is central to our success to not have someone focused on it entirely.

You'll find exceptional people, but you won't just be the person holding everyone to a bar - you'll work with the founders and leadership team to shape what that bar actually looks like.

This isn't a role where you speak to candidates and move them through a process. You'll understand the product, business and teams deeply enough to assess people properly, challenge hiring managers when needed, and hold the business to the same standard we expect from candidates.

And because you'll often be the first person someone meets from Odin, you'll need to give exceptional people a reason to care about a company many of them haven't heard of yet.

Employer brand is a core part of the role, not something you get to once hiring goes quiet. You'll help build the content, events and community engine that puts Odin in front of the best operators in tech before they're looking for their next job - and makes hiring easier over time.

Responsibilities

title: Member of Technical Staff (EMEA)
description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role:


As a Member of Technical Staff on the EMEA field team, you build on top of one of the largest inference platforms in the world. The work spans the stack: capabilities on top of inference and serving, tooling around fine-tuning and post-training of LLMs, and the product our region’s customers need that the core platform team will not take on. You are first and foremost an excellent software engineer; that is what we are testing for. You prefer building product to being customer-facing, and that is exactly right for this role, though you are welcome to join customer work when it interests you.

 

Treat this as a flexible role: a bucket for exceptional builders at different levels of experience rather than a fixed job spec. There is no specific seniority requirement; anywhere from 3 to 10 years of experience can fit.

 

What we value most is first principles thinking: reasoning about unfamiliar problems from the ground up rather than from playbooks. You will be evaluated on this directly in the interview process, and strength here can outweigh gaps elsewhere in your background.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build: Design and ship product capabilities end to end, from ambiguous need to running in production.

  • Build on Inference: Create capabilities on top of the serving stack: routing, model controls, observability, and whatever a deployment turns out to need.

  • Build on Training: Ship tooling around fine-tuning and post-training of LLMs, from data pipelines to evaluation, working alongside our applied ML engineers.

  • Own Regional Capability: Turn EMEA-specific requirements into product, working with core platform where the line is unclear.

  • Engineering Quality: Set the engineering bar for the regional team; your code is the reference.

title: IT | OT Security Architekt (m/w/d)
description:
Die APT-ONE GmbH in Berlin ist ein auf Cyber Security spezialisiertes Beratungshaus. Wir schützen die IT-, OT-, Cloud- und KI-Systeme unserer Kunden wirksam vor digitalen Bedrohungen.

Unser Ansatz ist anders: KI-gestützte Werkzeuge übernehmen Discovery, Routine-Analysen und Mustererkennung – unsere Berater:innen validieren, interpretieren und konzentrieren sich auf Strategie und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen. KI nur mit höchster Sensibilität für Kundendaten: Datenschutz steht über jedem Effizienzgewinn. KI ausschließlich auf vertraglich abgesicherten, datenschutzkonformen Plattformen, minimierte und anonymisierte Daten, niemals Kundendaten im Modelltraining. Diesen Umgang – und die Bereitschaft,
unsere Prozesse und Produkte kontinuierlich mit KI weiterzuentwickeln – erwarten wir von allen Berater:innen.

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn:

  • du ein attraktives Fixgehalt plus überdurchschnittliche Gewinnbeteiligung willst.
  • du ortsunabhängig an hochrelevanten Projekten in Security Operations und KI-Sicherheit arbeiten willst.
  • du KI als Hebel siehst und Sicherheitsberatung neu denken willst – ohne Kompromisse beim Datenschutz.

Aufgaben

  • Durchführung von Threat Modeling, Architektur-Reviews und Risikoanalysen für Anwendungen, Netzwerke, Cloud-Workloads und Plattformen
  • Design von Netzwerk- und Perimetersicherheit inkl. Segmentierung, Firewalling und Zero Trust Network Access – On-Premises und in der Cloud

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

 

About the Role

The CTO will own technology strategy, architecture and engineering standards across the Group. This is a technical leadership role for someone who can operate across multiple businesses while remaining close to systems, architecture and engineering execution.

 

What you will be doing

  • Own architecture and major technical decisions across group products and platforms.

  • Review critical systems, architecture, infrastructure and code directly.

  • Set engineering standards across reliability, security, performance, testing and code quality.

  • Identify technical debt and architecture constraints and drive their resolution.

  • Improve engineering productivity, development speed and production reliability.

  • Decide where technology and infrastructure should be shared across Group businesses.

  • Recruit and assess senior engineers, technical leads and engineering leaders.

 

What you will need

  • Deep software engineering background with experience building and scaling production systems.

  • Strong knowledge of backend systems, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.

  • Experience making architecture decisions across multiple products or engineering teams.

  • Strong technical judgement and ability to challenge engineering decisions at implementation level.

  • Capable of building world-class engineering teams.

  • Still technically hands-o

title: GenAI Engineering Coach (m/w/d) - Hybrid (deutschlandweite Standorte)
description:
Vollzeit · deutschlandweit · Hybrid mit projektbezogenen Kundenterminen

Dein künftiger Arbeitgeber ist eines der führenden IT-Beratungshäuser im deutschsprachigen Raum – technikgetrieben, mittelständisch geprägt und mit GenAI als erklärter Top-Priorität des gesamten Unternehmens. Es gibt eine offizielle Partnerschaft mit einem der weltweit führenden AI-Labs, über 200 Kolleg:innen durchlaufen aktuell die zugehörige Architektur-Zertifizierung, und agentische Softwareentwicklung ist hier kein Experiment einzelner Teams, sondern Firmenstrategie mit eigenem Vorgehensmodell.

In dieser Rolle bist du der Zündfunke: Du machst Kundenorganisationen fit im Umgang mit AI-gestützter Entwicklung – und ziehst weiter, sobald das Team läuft. Ehrlich gesagt: Das ist kundengetriebene Beratungsarbeit mit wechselnden Einsätzen von drei bis sechs Monaten, inklusive Workshops und Angebotsunterstützung. Wer eine interne Enablement-Rolle oder Produktentwicklung sucht, wird hier nicht glücklich. Wer aber Wirkung in Serie will, findet kaum ein besseres Spielfeld.

Aufgaben

  • Du coachst Kundenorganisationen bei der Einführung von AI-Coding-Werkzeugen – von der Toollandschaft (Copilot, Cursor, MCP) bis zur gelebten Arbeitsweise im Team.
  • Du baust Governance und Guardrails auf, damit AI-gestützte Entwicklung beim Kunden nicht nur schnell, sondern auch sicher und regelkonform läuft.
  • Du konzipierst Einführungsprogramme und entwickelst selbst mit – von PoCs bis zu Referenzimplementierungen im Enterprise-Standardstack (z. B. Java/Spring Boot, TypeScript/React). Du bist Coach mit Commit-Historie, kein Folien-Berater.
  • Du unterstützt in Workshops und Angebotssituationen als technisches Gesicht des Themas – auf Augenhöhe mit Entwicklern wie mit Entscheidern.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst einen echten technischen Background aus der Softwareentwicklung mit – du hast selbst jahrelang in komplexen Enterprise-Projekten gebaut, nicht nur darüber gesprochen.
  • Du arbeitest produktiv mit AI-Coding-Werkzeugen wie Claude Code, Copilot oder Cursor – im echten Projektalltag, nicht nur im Wochenend-Experiment.
  • Du kannst Wissen übertragen: Teams enablen, Widerstände abholen, Arbeitsweisen verändern – und du magst genau diesen Teil der Arbeit.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C1-Niveau (plus gutes Englisch) und willst bewusst ins kundengetriebene Projektgeschäft – mit wechselnden Einsätzen statt Dauerprojekt.

Benefits

  • Ein Umfeld mit offizieller AI-Lab-Partnerschaft und der wohl größten Austausch-Community an AI-Praktikern im deutschsprachigen Raum – über 200 Kolleg:innen in Zertifizierung.
  • Strategie statt Experiment: eigenes Vorgehensmodell für agentische Entwicklung, Entwicklungszyklen von 2–4 Tagen statt Wochen-Sprints, riesiges internes Momentum.
  • Projekte mit Zugkraft: agentische Modernisierung von Legacy-Landschaften und AI-Integrat

title: Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x) in the field of AI & Satellite Data
description:

LiveEO uses satellite data and AI to monitor critical infrastructure at scale. As a Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x), you’ll sit at the heart of our operations, working with geospatial and satellite data to make sure our analytics projects are delivered reliably, accurately, and on time.

You’ll work closely with Project Managers, our Operations Support Studio, engineers, and product teams - investigating data, understanding our analytics pipelines, solving delivery issues, and helping us continuously improve how our technology performs in real-world use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure.

This role is a maternity leave cover and is offered on a fixed-term contract for 1 year.


Your challenge

  • Analyze, validate, and interpret geospatial and satellite data across global customer projects
  • Take ownership of analytics deliveries and help ensure high technical quality and reliability

Your profile

  • A degree in geoinformatics, remote sensing, geography, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, or another quantitative/technical field

title: Software Engineer, Platform
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. 

Overview

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API
  • Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break
  • Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on
  • Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for
  • Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat
  • Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us

title: Senior Product / UX Designer
description:
About GlassFlow:

GlassFlow is the data infrastructure for AI agents in production. It has two products: GlassFlow Tares, which feeds agents correlated data from every system they touch, and GlassFlow Rius, which traces and debugs what agents do once they're running.

We’re a Berlin startup with a Silicon Valley mentality, backed with $5.9m from Upfront Ventures, the CEO of GitHub, the ex-CTO of Aiven, and more world-class investors.

The founders are serial entrepreneurs with more +10y of experience in building and selling data products.

Tasks

Your Role

As the first design hire, you'll get to lay the design foundations of GlassFlow. As a product/UX designer you will be bringing the voice of the user to life in product and design by conducting user research, interviews and surveys, and translating them into sitemaps, user flows, customer journey maps, wireframes, mockups and high-fidelity prototypes. Your design decisions will directly impact the user experience and overall success of GlassFlow.

You will collaborate directly with our CTO and engineering team and work closely with our lead frontend engineer. You will join a small team solving challenging problems in the field of Data engineering and building a product that will be used by developers across the world.

Requirements

Previous experience that could be helpful

  • 4+ years of experience as a product or UX designer, ideally for a dev tool product
  • Ability to conduct user testing and knowledge of user research methods
  • Proficiency in Figma, or comparable prototyping tools
  • Efficient communicator with experience working with cross-functional teams, including software engineers
  • Worked in fast-growing environments or early-stage startups

Benefits

What you’ll get

  • Real ownership: competitive equity (everyone at GlassFlow is an owner).
  • The chance to build something that changes how the world streams data.
  • The opportunity to build for global tech brands from day one.
  • A career trajectory that will 10x your skills and network.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with Stock Option Grant
  • Ticket for public transportation in Berlin
  • Company credit card with a monthly allowance
  • Newest tech of your choosing
  • Annual Learning budget for personal development
  • Generous WFH policy and a budget for home office setup

GlassFlow is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in the workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including those with diverse backgrounds and disabilities.

title: Solution Architect (all genders)
description:
Your creative field

We are looking for two full-time, permanent Solution Architects to start as soon as possible. We're filling this role at two levels. See below where you recognise yourself. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.


You open your laptop in the morning and know that today will probably be different from what you planned. Maybe you're in a refinement session and realise halfway through that the proposed solution won't hold up at scale. Maybe a developer asks a question that makes you rethink a concept you thought was finished last week. Some days are structured, some aren't – but you know how to work with both.

This isn't a greenfield. At Contabo Group, two systems run in parallel: a PHP monolith with 15 years in production, grown across multiple teams and generations of decisions and a younger microservice system with a message broker built over the last few years. Together they serve more than 250,000 customers worldwide. You know that a landscape like this has its own logic and that you don't redraw it from scratch, but take the time to understand it before you start changing it.

Your job is to develop this landscape further. That means retiring legacy systems where it makes sense, keeping the architecture clean even when there's business pressure to cut corners, and bringing teams along rather than issuing mandates. You own the solution architecture across software, infrastructure and networking – and you make sure decisions are made transparently, not in a vacuum. If you naturally share what you know, not because it's in the job description but because you understand that bad architecture eventually hits everyone – then this is likely the right place for you. 


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:  

Must have:
• Architectural knowledge for complex, distributed systems 
• Solid understanding of the hosting domain – you know what happens behind a VPS booking 
• Systems modelling with UML, C4, BPMN, ERD, or FMC (e.g. Drawio, Visio, Mermaid) 
• 5+ years of experience, with 2+ years focused on architecture 
• Fluent in German and English 
 
Should have: 
• Experience with Kubernetes, Ansible, or comparable IaC tools 
• Some or deep experience migrating monolithic systems to microservices 
• Mentoring background 
 
Nice to have: 
• AI tools in everyday development (e.g. Claude Code) 
 
We're filling this role at two levels. See where you recognise yourself: 
 
Senior - You own the full architecture responsibility and set the standard for all teams.

title: Senior Backend-Entwickler – Agents (100% Remote / German-Speaking)
description:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

Über uns
Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

  • Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?

  • Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills?

  • Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets.

  • LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist.

title: Senior Applied Research Engineer - Video
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As an Applied Research Engineer in our Video team, you will help build the next generation of production-grade foundation models for human-centric video generation.

You will join a highly focused team working at the intersection of large-scale generative modeling, distributed systems, and production engineering. Our mission is to develop and optimize video base models that power realistic, controllable, and emotionally expressive synthetic humans at scale.

This is not pure research. This is applied research with direct product impact.

You will work on advancing training recipes, scaling distributed systems, improving evaluation frameworks, and optimizing inference to ensure our models are high quality, stable, and efficient enough for real-world deployment. Your work will directly influence models used by tens of thousands of businesses worldwide.

What you’ll do

You will own and execute end-to-end research and engineering projects, from hypothesis to production impact. This includes:

  • Developing and scaling latent video diffusion models tailored for human-centric video generation

  • Designing conditioning mechanisms to improve control (pose, emotion, script, camera) without sacrificing fidelity

  • Advancing distributed training strategies (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, sequence parallelism) under real compute constraints

  • Improving training stability at multi-node scale

  • Designing rigorous evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics and structured human evaluation

  • Optimizing inference for low latency, high resolution, and cost efficiency<

title: Director of Product
description:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

 

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the role.

Zilch operates in a fast-paced, highly competitive global market. Though still young, we are one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs - and we’re looking for a Director of Product to lead the next phase of innovation and growth.

In this role, you’ll drive the development of new financial products, intelligent purchase experiences powered by AI, and data-driven commerce capabilities that make Zilch the top-of-wallet choice for customers. You will lead five product squads, delivering the most efficient and flexible ways for customers to pay, manage credit, and shop using Zilch-issued Visa cards.

As a hands-on product leader, you’ll combine strategic ownership with deep involvement in product discovery, delivery, and optimisation. You’ll set high standards for your teams - mentoring, challenging, and empowering them to turn complex problems into scalable, high-impact products. You'll also be accountable for driving the P&L for your portfolio, ensuring every initiative delivers measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

What you'll do.

  • Lead and empower five cross-functional product squads to deliver high-impact outcomes across purchase, payments, and repayment journeys.

  • Drive the P&L and commercial performance of Zilch's financial and payment products, driving sustainable growth and strong unit economics.

  • Define product strategy and roadmaps across multiple squads, aligning priorities with Zilch's commercial and growth objectives.

  • Set clear product goals, monitor KPIs, and use data, experimentation, and customer insight to continuously optimise performance and customer value.

  • Demonstrate hands-on product leadership by driving discovery, shaping solutions, and partnering closely with Engineering and Design throughout delivery.

  • Balance long-term product strategy with day-to-day execution, ensuring teams consistently deliver customer and business impact.

description:
Your mission

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including significant ownership of infrastructure, platform, or developer tooling products.

title: Ecommerce Brand Manager
description:
Entropy sells survival, power and preparedness gear in the US. Around $525k a year, currently at contribution margin neutral. Almost all of it is other people's product resold at 9-12% margin, which caps what the business can earn.

Own-brand product and better acquisition economics are the fix. That's the job.

You'd own the P&L and report to Jack and Lasse weekly. Nobody else is doing this.

Tasks

  • Own blended gross margin, moving it from 12% to 25%, and take the business through breakeven.
  • Source and launch own-brand SKUs. Suppliers, MOQ negotiation, samples, freight, duty, 3PL, listings, launch.
  • Run paid acquisition yourself. Google Shopping, PMax and Search. There's no agency and there won't be one.
  • Site and conversion work. Product pages, imagery, copy, checkout, cart abandonment.
  • Build attach and post-purchase revenue. Checkout upsells, replenishment, email flows.
  • Restart the content engine. Video cadence, TikTok, YouTube, UGC and reviews.
  • Manage the existing dropship catalogue on margin, cutting what doesn't pay.
  • First 90 days: paid spend cut on every SKU below 15% margin, even where that drops revenue. Google Ads moved in-house. First own-brand order placed. Attach offers live at checkout. Blended gross margin at 16%.

Requirements

Must have:

  • Launched a physical product end to end. Sourced it, negotiated MOQ, approved samples, managed freight, priced it, listed it, sold it
  • Run Google Ads yourself on a Shopping-led store. In the account, not briefing an agency
  • Owned a gross margin or P&L number, not a revenue or ROAS number
  • Operated at $500k-5m, where you wrote the product page and answered the customer emails
  • Comfortable cutting revenue to fix margin
  • Work independently. No team, no budget approver, nobody checking your work between weekly calls

Nice to have:

  • Built checkout attach, upsells or replenishment flows
  • Sold consumables or anything with repeat purchase
  • Worked with Chinese suppliers, or US co-packers and contract manufacturers
  • US import, duty classification, 3PL setup
  • Klaviyo or equivalent, built from scratch rather than inherited
  • Bundle and kit pricing
  • Preparedness, outdoor, hunting or adjacent category knowledge

We're also open to people from outside ecom. Founders whose company didn't work out, consultants who want to operate, anyone who has built something and can show it. The mechanics are learnable. The instinct isn't.

Not for you if you want a team, a budget, or someone telling you what to do next week. Or if a 25% revenue drop in month one would be a problem.

Benefits

€65-75,000 base. Equity from 5%, up to 10% earned against margin and profitability targets. Quarterly bonus on gross margin. Fully remote, anywhere in Europe

title: AI Data Architect - Knowledge & Governance
description:
We Want You to Grow With Us

The intelligence of any AI system is only as good as the knowledge it is built upon, and this role is responsible for making that knowledge trustworthy, structured, and enduring. As our AI Data Architect for Knowledge & Governance, you will design and build the enterprise-grade knowledge backbone that powers Intersnack's AI programme: knowledge graphs, semantic models, vector spaces, and the RAG architectures that connect them to agentic workflows. You will report into the AI Programme and act as a key voice in shaping not just the technical architecture, but the governance and security frameworks that ensure AI is deployed safely, explainably, and in full compliance with applicable regulation. This is a role for someone who wants to build something that lasts: a change-resilient knowledge infrastructure that scales across procurement, manufacturing, sales, and beyond.

What We Can Offer

This role sits at the architectural heart of Intersnack's AI transformation, giving you the rare opportunity to define the knowledge foundation from the ground up rather than inherit a legacy system. You will have significant design authority, shaping ontologies, graph architectures, and governance frameworks that will influence how AI operates across a business present in more than 30 countries. Working alongside data engineers, AI engineers, and business stakeholders, you will contribute to a collaborative environment where architecture decisions have visible, measurable impact. Flexibility between Dusseldorf and remote working supports a working model that suits your needs, while the international scope of the programme ensures continuous exposure to complex, real-world challenges at scale.

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next AI Data Architect - Knowledge & Governance

You will spend your time designing the structural intelligence layer that makes enterprise AI possible: building knowledge graphs, semantic models, and vector spaces that ground AI outputs in trusted, governed organisational knowledge. Alongside the technical build, you will lead the governance and security-by-design practices that ensure every data asset, model, and AI use case meets Intersnack's standards for explainability, traceability, and regulatory compliance.

What You Will Do

  • Design and build AI-ready knowledge graphs, semantic models, and vector spaces that form the trusted knowledge backbone for analytics and agentic AI across the enterprise

  • Architect RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and agent grounding frameworks, defining the design vision

title: Payment Operations Lead
description:
Payment Operations Lead

Global expansion is broken. Without a local company, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Selling internationally is a maze of tax, payments, and operational friction. Most brands avoid it, or expand slowly and expensively.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce.

Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we become liable for a merchant's taxes. Sometimes we become the legal reseller in each market and carry the payments, tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

We go live wherever a merchant needs to sell next, for digital and physical goods. That means we own the full stack - payments, tax, compliance, treasury, and merchant experience.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're looking for a Payment Operations hire to own the part of Outpost where the money actually moves.

When we become the legal reseller in a market, we take the payment. Every merchant we onboard gets its own merchant ID and its own merchant category code, never pooled into one shared code, which is exactly why our approval rates beat the alternatives. Keeping that true across every market, every processor and every merchant is the job.

This is a quantitative role in an operational seat. You'll live in the transaction data: why authorisation rates differ by market, issuer, card type and hour of day, what a routing change is actually worth, where a 40 basis point cost difference is hiding, which decline codes are recoverable and which are noise. Then you'll act on it, with processors, with engineering, and with merchants.

You won't be siloed. Payments at Outpost touches pricing, treasury, tax and the product roadmap, and you'll be pulled into all of it. But your edge is the numbers, and we want someone whose first instinct on any problem is to pull the data and model it.

You'll work directly with the founding team and with engineering, who will build what you spec.

🧗 What You'll Get

Yes, the work is intense. But in return you'll get scope and exposure most people wait 10 to 20 years to access.

You'll own economics that decide whether the company is profitable, negotiate with processors and banks as a principal rather than a customer,

We're looking for our Head of Operations: the person who owns how Outpost actually runs.

description:
Your creative field

We are looking for two full-time, permanent Solution Architects to start as soon as possible. We're filling this role at two levels. See below where you recognise yourself. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.


You open your laptop in the morning and know that today will probably be different from what you planned. Maybe you're in a refinement session and realise halfway through that the proposed solution won't hold up at scale. Maybe a developer asks a question that makes you rethink a concept you thought was finished last week. Some days are structured, some aren't – but you know how to work with both.

This isn't a greenfield. At Contabo Group, two systems run in parallel: a PHP monolith with 15 years in production, grown across multiple teams and generations of decisions and a younger microservice system with a message broker built over the last few years. Together they serve more than 250,000 customers worldwide. You know that a landscape like this has its own logic and that you don't redraw it from scratch, but take the time to understand it before you start changing it.

Your job is to develop this landscape further. You own the solution architecture across software, infrastructure and networking – and you make sure decisions are made transparently, not in a vacuum. Endear is building the first modern CRM for retail teams. We empower brands to drive more in-store sales by giving their retail teams AI-powered tools to have 10x more personalized, human conversations with customers. Despite retail being 6x larger than eCommerce, brick-and-mortar retail has been largely overlooked by the technology industry. We're changing that by enabling thousands of salespeople to leverage customer data in meaningful ways.

Founded 5 years ago, Endear has demonstrated strong product-market fit and reached profitability multiple times. Our platform was built from the ground up by technical leaders who have scaled data platforms to hundreds of millions of users and been at startups from early-stage through IPO. We make measured, high-conviction decisions at every milestone to ensure long-term success while realizing our massive potential in the retail market.

Our Work Environment

  • Remote-first culture built on trust and autonomy

  • Small, highly effective team (20-ish employees)

  • Fast-paced environment with shifting priorities

  • High-ownership culture where outcomes matter

  • Collaborative atmosphere that values learning and teaching

About the Role

We are seeking an account manager with a passion for helping our existing customers in a variety of ways to ensure their long term success with Endear. Our dream candidate is self-motivated and has an entrepreneur-like attitude towards their work. In other words, you like owning your process and the results that follow. You have a solutions-first approach to helping customers, with an eye on how support can result in upsells, referrals, and expansion

What You'll Own

  • Develop strong relationships with customers to ensure their success with Endear.

  • Perform customer trainings and onboardings with screenshare app walkthroughs and Q&A’s.

  • Periodically check in on account health & performance to spot any potential drop offs in adoption.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the performance of customer accounts through strategic guidance, problem solving, and providing needed materials.

  • Guide customers through the expansion/renewal process.

  • Develop resources and assets both video and written to improve customer success at Endear.

description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong accounting foundation who is excited to work directly with customers and help finance teams modernize how they operate. You may come from Big 4 audit, accounting advisory, finance transformation, or an operational accounting role at a high-growth technology company. Du verantwortest die Frage:

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE): United Kingdom
